function.name: resize_video
function.description: Resize the video or photo to the specified width and height. This filter scales the frame dimensions. Works on photos (jpg/png/webp/heic) as well as videos.

width.description: The new width in pixels. Must be a positive even number for most codecs.

height.description: The new height in pixels. Must be a positive even number for most codecs. Use -1 to auto-scale based on width.

function.name: crop_video
function.description: Crop a region of the video or photo starting from the specified top-left corner with given width and height. Useful for removing borders or focusing on a part of the frame. Works on photos (jpg/png/webp/heic) as well as videos.

x.description: The x-coordinate of the top-left corner of the crop area.

y.description: The y-coordinate of the top-left corner of the crop area.

width.description: The width of the crop area in pixels.

height.description: The height of the crop area in pixels.

function.name: rotate_video
function.description: Rotate the video or photo by the specified angle in degrees. Common for correcting orientation, e.g., 90 for clockwise, -90 for counter-clockwise. Works on photos (jpg/png/webp/heic) as well as videos.

angle.description: The rotation angle in degrees. Positive for clockwise, negative for counter-clockwise.

function.name: flip_video_horizontal
function.description: Flip the video or photo horizontally (mirror effect) along the vertical axis. Works on photos (jpg/png/webp/heic) as well as videos.

function.name: add_text
function.description: Overlay text on the video or photo at a specified position with customizable size and color. Works on photos (jpg/png/webp/heic) as well as videos.

text.description: The text to overlay on the video.

function.name: trim_video
function.description: Trim the video to keep only the portion between the start and end times. Times can be in seconds or HH:MM:SS format. Videos only — not supported for photos.

function.name: adjust_speed
function.description: Change the playback speed of the video and audio. A factor >1 speeds up, <1 slows down. Videos only — not supported for photos.

speed.description: The speed factor (e.g., 2 for double speed, 0.5 for half speed).

function.name: adjust_audio_volume
function.description: Adjust the volume level of the audio track. Can be used to make audio louder or quieter.

volume.description: Volume multiplier (e.g., 0.5 for half volume, 2.0 for double volume, 1.0 for no change).

function.name: audio_fade
function.description: Apply fade in or fade out effect to the audio. Useful for smooth transitions at the beginning or end of videos.

type.description: Type of fade: "in" for fade in at start, "out" for fade out at end.

duration.description: Duration of the fade effect in seconds.

start.description: Optional. Time in seconds from the beginning of the clip at which the fade begins; the fade runs from start to start + duration. Fade in: silent before start, rising to full volume by start + duration. Fade out: full volume until start, silent from start + duration on. If omitted, a fade in starts at 0 and a fade out starts at (clip length - duration, not below 0), so it ends at the end of the clip.

function.name: resize_video_preset
function.description: Resize video or photo to a preset aspect ratio optimized for specific social media platforms and use cases. Works on photos (jpg/png/webp/heic) as well as videos.

preset.description: The aspect ratio preset to use.

function.name: adjust_brightness
function.description: Adjust the brightness level of the video or photo. Can be used to make it lighter or darker. Works on photos (jpg/png/webp/heic) as well as videos.

brightness.description: Brightness adjustment value. Range: -1.0 to 1.0. Negative values darken the video, positive values brighten it. 0 means no change.

function.name: adjust_hue
function.description: Rotate the hue (color) of the video or photo. Shifts all colors by the specified angle on the color wheel. Works on photos (jpg/png/webp/heic) as well as videos.

degrees.description: Hue rotation angle in degrees. Range: -360 to 360. 0 means no change, 180 inverts colors.

function.name: adjust_saturation
function.description: Adjust the color saturation (intensity) of the video or photo. Can make colors more vivid or more muted (0 = grayscale). Works on photos (jpg/png/webp/heic) as well as videos.

saturation.description: Saturation multiplier. Range: 0 to 3. Values < 1 desaturate (0 = grayscale), values > 1 oversaturate, 1 = no change.

function.name: get_video_dimensions
function.description: Get the dimensions (width and height) and other metadata of the video such as duration, codec, and frame rate.

function.name: convert_video_format
function.description: Convert video from one format to another. Supports common formats like mp4, webm, mov, avi, mkv, flv, etc. For photos use convert_image_format instead.

format.description: The target format to convert to: "mp4" or "mov".

codec.description: Optional: Video codec to use. Common codecs: "libx264" (H.264), "libx265" (H.265), "libvpx-vp9" (VP9 for WebM).

function.name: get_supported_formats
function.description: Introspect and retrieve the list of supported video and audio formats for file conversion. Call this tool before using convert_video_format or convert_audio_format to know which target formats are available.

function.name: generate_captions
function.description: Generate same-language subtitles from the video audio with on-device speech recognition (SRT/VTT). Use ISO language codes when possible (en, es, fr, de, ja, zh). When burn_in is true (default), burns the captions into the video; when false, adds a soft subtitle track only. This tool never translates: for captions in another language ("add Chinese captions", "translate the video into Chinese") call lyric_captions instead. Use for accessibility or social content in the spoken language. Videos only — not supported for photos.

language.description: Spoken language of the audio for transcription. Prefer ISO codes: "en", "es", "fr", "de", "ja", "zh". Use "auto" if unknown. Do NOT pass sentences.

style.description: Burn-in subtitle style (only when burn_in is true): "default", "white_on_black", or "yellow".

position.description: Burn-in position for the captions: "bottom" (default) or "top".

burn_in.description: If true (default), burn subtitles into the video frames. If false, only a soft SRT/VTT track (no re-render).

function.name: lyric_captions
function.description: Translated captions, run by the app: the original line plus a translation, for speech and for songs. This is the tool for any request to caption or subtitle the video in another language, e.g. "add Chinese captions", "add captions in Chinese", "Chinese subtitles", "translate the video into Chinese and burn the captions", "translate the speech to Spanish", and for music: "add lyrics captions", "subtitle the song in Chinese", "translate the lyrics on the video to Spanish". Set mode "speech" for ordinary talking (interviews, vlogs, dialogue: only obvious recognition errors are fixed, no song lookup), mode "lyrics" for a song or music video, and leave mode "auto" if unsure. Fill target_language from the language the user wants the translation in (Chinese is "zh-Hans" unless they ask for Traditional, then "zh-Hant"); the spoken or sung language is detected automatically, so set source_language only if they name it. If they name two languages ("in German and Chinese"), the sung language is the source and the other is target_language. If they name no translation language, ask which one they want. The app asks the user before uploading anything, then sends only this video's audio (never the picture) to FinalCap, which transcribes it, translates each line (for songs it also identifies the song and checks the words against the published lyrics); the app then draws two-line captions on the video (original on top, translation below, about 20% up from the bottom). If Cloud processing is off or the user says Not now, nothing is uploaded and the step is skipped: do not call it again this turn. The result names the language(s) and, for songs, the song, never the lyrics or the speech text; do not quote lines back. Use generate_captions only for same-language subtitles without translation. Videos only — not supported for photos.

target_language.description: Language for the translation line, as a code or name: "zh-Hans", "zh-Hant", "es", "ja", "English".

source_language.description: Sung/spoken language as a code ("en", "de", "ko"), or "auto" (default) to detect it.

mode.description: "lyrics" for a song (identify it and correct lyrics), "speech" for talking (fix obvious errors only), or "auto" (default) to decide.

position_from_bottom_pct.description: Caption baseline height above the bottom edge, as a percentage of the video height (0-45). Default 20.

font_size.description: Optional font size in video pixels. Default is about video height / 27. Prefer "size".

font.description: Caption font. Default "Noto Sans CJK SC" (Bold; draws Chinese, Japanese and Latin). "Inter" is Latin only.

size.description: Caption size: "small", "default", "large" or "xl". Default "default" (48 px on a 720x1280 video, scaled).

position.description: Where the captions go: "bottom" (default, about 20% up; position_from_bottom_pct moves it), "middle" or "top".

function.name: apply_color_filter
function.description: Apply a color filter / tint / look to the photo or video, e.g. "apply a red filter", "make it black and white", "sepia", "vintage", "warm tones". Works on photos (jpg/png/webp/heic) as well as videos.

intensity.description: Filter strength from 0.0 (no effect) to 1.0 (full effect). Default 1.0. Ignored for invert and vintage.

function.name: adjust_contrast
function.description: Adjust the contrast of the photo or video. Works on photos (jpg/png/webp/heic) as well as videos.

contrast.description: Contrast multiplier. Range: 0 to 3. 1 = no change, >1 more contrast, <1 less contrast.

function.name: flip_video_vertical
function.description: Flip the photo or video vertically (upside-down mirror along the horizontal axis). Works on photos as well as videos.

function.name: convert_image_format
function.description: Convert a photo to another image format (jpg, png, webp). Photos only — use convert_video_format for videos.

function.name: ffmpeg_cli
function.description: FALLBACK ONLY. Use when none of the other tools can do what the user asks, and try it BEFORE telling the user something is not supported. Runs FFmpeg directly. First call with action "discover" and a query to find matching FFmpeg filters/codecs (add help_topic to read the FFmpeg help for a filter), then "plan" to validate a command and show the user what it will do, then "run" to execute it.

action.description: discover = search FFmpeg filters/codecs/encoders; plan = build and validate a command without running it; run = build, validate and execute.

query.description: For discover: one or two keywords such as "reverb", "vignette" or "h265". Any keyword may match; retry with different words if nothing is found.

help_topic.description: For discover: optional filter name to fetch its full FFmpeg help (ffmpeg -h filter=NAME).

output_format.description: Output container/extension, e.g. mp4, gif, mp3.

If Cloud processing is off or the user says Not now, nothing is uploaded and the step is skipped: do not call it again this turn. The result names the language(s) and, for songs, the song, never the lyrics or the speech text; do not quote lines back. Use generate_captions only for same-language subtitles without translation. Videos only — not supported for photos.

target_language.description: Language for the translation line, as a code or name: "zh-Hans", "zh-Hant", "es", "ja", "English".

source_language.description: Sung/spoken language as a code ("en", "de", "ko"), or "auto" (default) to detect it.

mode.description: "lyrics" for a song (identify it and correct lyrics), "speech" for talking (fix obvious errors only), or "auto" (default) to decide.

position_from_bottom_pct.description: Caption baseline height above the bottom edge, as a percentage of the video height (0-45). Default 20.

font_size.description: Optional font size in video pixels. Default is about video height / 27. Prefer "size".

font.description: Caption font. Default "Noto Sans CJK SC" (Bold; draws Chinese, Japanese and Latin). "Inter" is Latin only.

size.description: Caption size: "small", "default", "large" or "xl". Default "default" (48 px on a 720x1280 video, scaled).

position.description: Where the captions go: "bottom" (default, about 20% up; position_from_bottom_pct moves it), "middle" or "top".

function.name: apply_color_filter
function.description: Apply a color filter / tint / look to the photo or video, e.g. "apply a red filter", "make it black and white", "sepia", "vintage", "warm tones". Works on photos (jpg/png/webp/heic) as well as videos.

intensity.description: Filter strength from 0.0 (no effect) to 1.0 (full effect). Default 1.0. Ignored for invert and vintage.

function.name: adjust_contrast
function.description: Adjust the contrast of the photo or video. Works on photos (jpg/png/webp/heic) as well as videos.

contrast.description: Contrast multiplier. Range: 0 to 3. 1 = no change, >1 more contrast, <1 less contrast.

function.name: flip_video_vertical
function.description: Flip the photo or video vertically (upside-down mirror along the horizontal axis). Works on photos as well as videos.

function.name: ffmpeg_cli
function.description: FALLBACK ONLY. Use when none of the other tools can do what the user asks, and try it BEFORE telling the user something is not supported. Runs FFmpeg directly. First call with action "discover" and a query to find matching FFmpeg filters/codecs (add help_topic to read the FFmpeg help for a filter), then "plan" to validate a command and show the user what it will do, then "run" to execute it.

action.description: discover = search FFmpeg filters/codecs/encoders; plan = build and validate a command without running it; run = build, validate and execute.

query.description: For discover: one or two keywords such as "reverb", "vignette" or "h265". Any keyword may match; retry with different words if nothing is found.

help_topic.description: For discover: optional filter name to fetch its full FFmpeg help (ffmpeg -h filter=NAME).

output_format.description: Output container/extension, e.g. mp4, gif, mp3.

function.name: resize_video
function.description: Resize the video or photo to the specified width and height. This filter scales the frame dimensions. Works on photos (jpg/png/webp/heic) as well as videos.

width.description: The new width in pixels. Must be a positive even number for most codecs.

height.description: The new height in pixels. Must be a positive even number for most codecs. Use -1 to auto-scale based on width.

function.name: crop_video
function.description: Crop a region of the video or photo starting from the specified top-left corner with given width and height. Useful for removing borders or focusing on a part of the frame. Works on photos (jpg/png/webp/heic) as well as videos.

x.description: The x-coordinate of the top-left corner of the crop area.

y.description: The y-coordinate of the top-left corner of the crop area.

width.description: The width of the crop area in pixels.

height.description: The height of the crop area in pixels.

function.name: rotate_video
function.description: Rotate the video or photo by the specified angle in degrees. Common for correcting orientation, e.g., 90 for clockwise, -90 for counter-clockwise. Works on photos (jpg/png/webp/heic) as well as videos.

angle.description: The rotation angle in degrees. Positive for clockwise, negative for counter-clockwise.

function.name: flip_video_horizontal
function.description: Flip the video or photo horizontally (mirror effect) along the vertical axis. Works on photos (jpg/png/webp/heic) as well as videos.

function.name: add_text
function.description: Overlay text on the video or photo at a specified position with customizable size and color. Works on photos (jpg/png/webp/heic) as well as videos.

text.description: The text to overlay on the video.

function.name: resize_video_preset
function.description: Resize video or photo to a preset aspect ratio optimized for specific social media platforms and use cases. Works on photos (jpg/png/webp/heic) as well as videos.

preset.description: The aspect ratio preset to use.

function.name: adjust_brightness
function.description: Adjust the brightness level of the video or photo. Can be used to make it lighter or darker. Works on photos (jpg/png/webp/heic) as well as videos.

brightness.description: Brightness adjustment value. Range: -1.0 to 1.0. Negative values darken the video, positive values brighten it. 0 means no change.

function.name: adjust_hue
function.description: Rotate the hue (color) of the video or photo. Shifts all colors by the specified angle on the color wheel. Works on photos (jpg/png/webp/heic) as well as videos.

degrees.description: Hue rotation angle in degrees. Range: -360 to 360. 0 means no change, 180 inverts colors.

function.name: adjust_saturation
function.description: Adjust the color saturation (intensity) of the video or photo. Can make colors more vivid or more muted (0 = grayscale). Works on photos (jpg/png/webp/heic) as well as videos.

saturation.description: Saturation multiplier. Range: 0 to 3. Values < 1 desaturate (0 = grayscale), values > 1 oversaturate, 1 = no change.

function.name: get_video_dimensions
function.description: Get the dimensions (width and height) and other metadata of the video such as duration, codec, and frame rate.

function.name: get_supported_formats
function.description: Introspect and retrieve the list of supported video and audio formats for file conversion. Call this tool before using convert_video_format or convert_audio_format to know which target formats are available.

function.name: apply_color_filter
function.description: Apply a color filter / tint / look to the photo or video, e.g. "apply a red filter", "make it black and white", "sepia", "vintage", "warm tones". Works on photos (jpg/png/webp/heic) as well as videos.

intensity.description: Filter strength from 0.0 (no effect) to 1.0 (full effect). Default 1.0. Ignored for invert and vintage.

function.name: adjust_contrast
function.description: Adjust the contrast of the photo or video. Works on photos (jpg/png/webp/heic) as well as videos.

contrast.description: Contrast multiplier. Range: 0 to 3. 1 = no change, >1 more contrast, <1 less contrast.

function.name: flip_video_vertical
function.description: Flip the photo or video vertically (upside-down mirror along the horizontal axis). Works on photos as well as videos.

function.name: convert_image_format
function.description: Convert a photo to another image format (jpg, png, webp). Photos only — use convert_video_format for videos.
